Fasting Glucose Eligibility Limit
data.description: Glycemic eligibility condition assessed at screening
data.text: Fasting glucose >270 mg/dL (>15.0 mmol/L) confirmed by the central laboratory at screening (Visit 1) excludes the participant.

data.name: Renal Function Eligibility
data.description: Renal eligibility condition determined by central laboratory at screening
data.text: eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m2 calculated by eGFRcr-cys (CKD-EPI) determined by central laboratory during screening (Visit 1) excludes the participant.

data.name: PHQ-9 Threshold at Screening and Randomization
data.description: Depression screening condition evaluated at both Visit 1 and Visit 3 (randomization)
data.text: A PHQ-9 score of 15 or more at any screening visit (Visit 1) or at randomization (Visit 3) excludes the participant.

data.name: C-SSRS Suicidality Threshold
data.description: Suicidal ideation/behavior condition based on C-SSRS
data.text: "Yes" to Question 4 or 5 on the Suicidal Ideation portion of the C-SSRS with ideation within the past 3 months, OR "yes" to any suicide-related behavior within the past 5 years, excludes the participant. Non-suicidal self-injurious behavior is not considered a suicide-related behavior.

data.name: Baseline Fundus Photography Requirement
data.description: Procedural condition required before randomization
data.text: All participants will have a baseline fundus photography assessment prior to randomization (Visit 3). Qualifying fundus photographs obtained within 90 days before Visit 1 may be used for eligibility determination.

data.name: Insulin Use Prohibition During Study
data.description: Concomitant therapy condition for antihyperglycemic medication initiation
data.text: Insulin use for >=14 consecutive days is prohibited during the study (Section 6.9.1).

data.name: Severe, Persistent Hyperglycemia Requiring Rescue
data.description: Response-based condition triggering glycemic rescue therapy
data.text: Severe, persistent hyperglycemia triggers recommended glycemic rescue therapy; urgent use of short-term insulin in a hospital or closely monitored setting may be used as rescue therapy.

data.name: BMI Lower Limit Safety Condition
data.description: Safety condition triggering management/dose modification
data.text: Participants with BMI <=22 kg/m2 require management per Section 6.6.3.

data.name: Perceived Excessive Weight Reduction
data.description: Safety condition triggering management/dose modification
data.text: Participants with perceived excessive weight reduction require management per Section 6.6.4.

data.name: Intestinal Symptoms / Inadequate Nutrition or Dehydration
data.description: Tolerability conditions triggering dose modification management
data.text: Management of participants with intestinal symptoms (Section 6.6.1) and with inadequate nutrition or dehydration (Section 6.6.2) may require dose modification.

data.name: Liver Chemistry Stopping Condition
data.description: Hepatic safety condition for study drug interruption or discontinuation
data.text: Liver chemistry stopping criteria (Section 7.1.1) and hepatic safety monitoring criteria (Section 8.2.9) define thresholds for study drug interruption or discontinuation.

data.name: Enrollment Cap by Sex Assigned at Birth
data.description: Enrollment condition to ensure representation
data.text: An upper limit of approximately 70% enrollment of AFAB participants will be used to ensure a sufficient number of AMAB participants.

data.name: Randomization Ratio Assignment
data.description: Assignment condition for treatment arms
data.text: Approximately 1035 participants randomly assigned to placebo, eloralintide 1.5 mg, 3 mg, 6 mg, and 9 mg at a randomization ratio of 2:1:2:2:2.

data.name: Unscheduled Visit Condition
data.description: Investigator-driven visit condition
data.text: An unscheduled visit may occur per investigator discretion for clinical oversight. The study site will determine if fasting status is needed prior to the visit; concomitant medications, AEs, and endpoint events must be recorded in the CRF.

data.name: ED Procedures Exemption for Undosed Participants
data.description: Condition exempting participants from early discontinuation procedures
data.text: Participants who withdraw from the study after signing the informed consent but who have not taken a dose of study intervention do not need to complete ED procedures.

data.name: Screening to Treatment Transition
data.text: After an up to 35-day screening period (Visit 1 to Visit 3), participants meeting all eligibility criteria (including PHQ-9 <15 at Visit 3 and baseline fundus photography completed) are randomized at Visit 3 to placebo or eloralintide 1.5 mg, 3 mg, 6 mg, or 9 mg (2:1:2:2:2).

data.name: Dose Escalation to Maintenance Transition
data.text: Following the 12-week dose escalation period (stepping through 3 mg, 6 mg, and 9 mg every 4 weeks), participants enter the 52-week treatment maintenance period at their randomly assigned dose.

data.name: Treatment to Post-treatment Follow-up Transition
data.text: After completion of up to 64 weeks of treatment, participants enter a 6-week posttreatment follow-up period, with Visit 801 occurring approximately 6 weeks after the last treatment period visit or final treatment visit. All participants are required to complete the safety follow-up visit.

data.name: Dose Escalation Step Rule
data.text: To reach doses of 3 mg, 6 mg, and 9 mg QW, a dose-escalation regimen stepping through each of these doses every 4 weeks will be employed.

data.name: Dose Modification for Tolerability
data.text: Dose modification may occur for intestinal symptoms, inadequate nutrition or dehydration, BMI <=22 kg/m2, or perceived excessive weight reduction (Sections 6.6 through 6.6.4).

data.name: Rescue Therapy for Severe, Persistent Hyperglycemia
data.text: Participants must continue administering assigned study intervention unless insulin is used as short-term rescue therapy. Urgent use of short-term insulin in a hospital or closely monitored setting may be used as glycemic rescue therapy; insulin use for >=14 consecutive days is prohibited.

data.name: Temporary Study Intervention Interruption
data.text: Study intervention may be temporarily interrupted per Section 7.1.2, including for hepatic safety findings per Section 8.2.9.

data.name: Discontinuation for Liver Chemistry Stopping Criteria
data.text: Study intervention must be discontinued if liver chemistry stopping criteria are met (Section 7.1.1 / Section 8.2.9).

data.name: Discontinuation of Study Intervention
data.text: Study intervention may be permanently discontinued per Section 7.1; participants permanently discontinuing early from the study complete an early discontinuation (ED) visit and should also complete posttreatment follow-up visit(s).

data.name: ED Visit Substitution at Scheduled Visit
data.text: If the participant is discontinuing at the time of a scheduled visit, perform that visit as an ED visit.

data.name: Early Discontinuation from Study
data.description: Participants permanently discontinuing early from the study complete ED visit procedures per the SoA and should also complete posttreatment follow-up visit(s).

data.name: Participant Withdrawal Before First Dose
data.description: Participants who withdraw after signing informed consent but who have not taken a dose of study intervention exit without completing ED procedures.

data.name: Participant Discontinuation/Withdrawal from the Study
data.description: Participant may discontinue or withdraw from the study at any time per Section 7.2.

data.name: Lost to Follow-up
data.description: Participants lost to follow-up are handled per Section 7.3.

data.name: Study Completion
data.description: Completion of up to 64 weeks of treatment (12-week dose escalation plus 52-week maintenance) followed by the 6-week posttreatment safety follow-up visit (Visit 801), which all participants are required to complete.

data.name: Randomization Eligibility Decision
data.description: At Visit 3 (within 35 days of Visit 1), eligibility is confirmed (including PHQ-9 <15 and baseline fundus photography) and participants are randomized 2:1:2:2:2.

data.name: Screening Laboratory Eligibility Decision
data.description: At Visit 1, central laboratory fasting glucose, eGFR, PHQ-9, and C-SSRS results determine continued screening eligibility.

data.name: Dose Escalation Step Decision
data.description: Every 4 weeks during the 12-week dose escalation period, tolerability (intestinal symptoms, nutrition/hydration, BMI, excessive weight reduction) determines escalation to the next dose or dose modification.

data.name: Glycemic Rescue Decision
data.description: During treatment visits, severe persistent hyperglycemia triggers initiation of rescue therapy while continuing assigned study intervention unless short-term insulin rescue is used (<14 consecutive days).

data.name: Hepatic Safety Decision
data.description: Hepatic safety monitoring results determine temporary interruption or permanent discontinuation of study drug.
